text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 71 syringes of regadenoson 0.08 mg/mL, 5 mL. Current usage is 3.3 syringes per day, providing 21.4 days of supply on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show regadenoson is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate for approximately three weeks. Multiple manufacturers have product available and none appear on the FDA shortage list. No allocation or allocation risk is indicated by FDA at this time.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing from Astellas Pharma US, Inc. (buyer approves).
2. Qualify Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. Berkeley Heights plant as a secondary source (buyer approves; P&T committee acknowledges).
3. Evaluate Accord Healthcare Inc., Apotex Corp., and Baxter Healthcare Corporation for contract pricing and supply reliability (buyer approves; P&T committee acknowledges).
4. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report any status change to the committee (buyer approves).

Not recommended: No conservation protocols, therapeutic substitutions, or compounding initiatives are recommended at this time.
